purpose: Transparent, browser-local pediatric outpatient ABPM report-summary comparison. This rule set does not validate a device, ingest raw readings, establish a diagnosis, triage acute illness, calculate CKD MAP targets, or select treatment.

sources.title: Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring in Children and Adolescents: 2022 Update
sources.use: Pediatric ABPM thresholds, phenotype framework, quality conditions, diary-derived wake/sleep periods, dipping, and removal of BP load.

sources.title: Distribution of 24-h ambulatory blood pressure in children: normalized reference values and role of body dimensions
sources.use: Reference-data provenance for the under-13 report-transcribed p95 workflow.

sources.title: KDIGO Blood Pressure in CKD guideline resources
sources.use: Future, separate pediatric CKD 24-hour MAP review module; not used in phenotype classification.

scope.treatment: Active or undocumented antihypertensive treatment withholds the untreated diagnostic phenotype.

under13.method: For every period and component, use the lower of the validated report p95 and the fixed age-13 threshold. A value equal to the applicable threshold is abnormal.

classification.notDocumented: Does not become a negative answer; comparison can be shown but automated phenotype is withheld pending clinician review.
classification.notMet: Known failure; automated phenotype is withheld.

optimalStudyCriteria.minimumReadingFrequency: At least one reading per recorded hour including sleep.

quality.localSafetyPolicy: The preview withholds automated phenotype output when these criteria are known to fail. This does not assert that a suboptimal study lacks all clinical utility.

phenotypes.normalAbpm: All six means below the applicable threshold.
phenotypes.abnormalAbpm: Any period/component mean at or above the applicable threshold.

descriptors.dipping: Calculated separately for SBP and DBP from diary-derived wake/sleep means. Descriptive only; isolated nondipping does not create masked hypertension.

knownLimits: The under-13 p95 values are transcribed from a validated report in this release; embedded LMS calculation and reconciliation are future work requiring independently validated coefficients.
The CKD MAP target is not assessed in this report-summary pathway.
A public static test page is not PHI-safe.
